messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert (P2) — GPU memory pressure detected on pool gpu-prod-3 (host: gpu-03-eu). Metric: cuda_alloc_failures > 5/min. Auto-mitigation attempted: kvcache backoff. PD incident: PD12345.

DANA: ack. I’m taking active. starting investigation.

ryan: standing by for handoff. if this is kv-cache leaking we should drain pool and reroute to fallback.

maya: quick mitigation command if needed: `./tools/gpu-drain --pool gpu-prod-3 --grace 30s` — migrates sessions to CPU fallback and prevents new allocations.

DANA: running drain now.

DANA: ```
$ ./tools/gpu-drain --pool gpu-prod-3 --grace 30s
drain initiated for pool gpu-prod-3
migrating 12 active sessions to fallback
waiting for graceful disconnect...
```

DANA: tailing pod logs for redwood/gpt-small-v2, seeing repeated small alloc churn and kernel retries. suspect recent model quantize change.

maya: +1 check last deploys. could be a new quantization profile.

ryan: PD escalated to L2 due to repeat alloc failures; assigning to miguel-sre.

pagerduty: Escalation: L2 oncall miguel-sre notified for PD12345.

DANA: eviction progress: evicted 9 sessions gracefully, 3 forced. memory pressure trending down.

oncall-bot: auto-shedder: 10% pool eviction performed, fallback routing enabled for gpu-prod-3.

DANA: metrics update: GPU mem usage 92% -> 66% over ~3m, cuda_alloc_failures dropping to baseline.

maya: customer-impact check: request traces show a spike in 503s for redwood/gpt-small-v2 in eu-west-1 between 2026-04-09T08:12 and 08:24 UTC. ~650 requests affected, ~4% error rate. please loop in support.

DANA: actioned: rolled back last quantize-optim rollout (rev 3 -> rev 2) for gpt-small-v2. keeping pool drained for 15m to observe.

ryan: preparing summary for #incidents and will notify support to draft customer comms.

pagerduty: PD12345 acknowledged by miguel-sre.

miguel-sre: picked up L2. collecting kernel traces and device alloc hist. will follow up with root cause and timeline; initial hypothesis: quantization change increased transient allocation patterns causing kvcache churn + fragmentation.

DANA: logs and commands used attached above. will add step-by-step postmortem notes once L2 confirms root cause.

oncall-bot: closing active paging thread for oncall handoff. leave notes here if further action required; tag #incidents for postmortem when ready. :white_check_mark:
